descriptions.job-1getpym:
Overview 

The Global Seller Onboarding team works directly with sellers and internal teams to ensure they are able to take full advantage of Square’s products and services. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists work closely with teams within Sales & Account Management as well as Product Specialists and Product Marketing Managers to deliver a seamless and exceptional merchant experience and give key input into the product roadmaps for customer-facing developer products. Additionally, Global Seller Onboarding Specialists play a key role in merchant discovery and lead the final stages of the sale, working with Square's upmarket sellers and cross-functional teams to successfully implement and activate new accounts.

Square initially pioneered the simple self-service model to enable small businesses to take a payment. Now, we aspire to expand that same seamless experience up-market. This position will play a pivotal role in establishing seller success needed for us to drive growth, retention, and scale our services up-market. We’re working to find new and better ways to help businesses succeed on their own terms—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape tomorrow at Square.

Seller Onboarding Expert - L3 (IC)

You Will (Responsibilities):

Strategic Onboarding & Education (Estimated 70% of work)

  • Guide sellers (customers) to start transacting with Square quickly and with confidence, delivering high-quality onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s SMB and mid-market sellers
  • Lead seller-facing scoping and onboarding calls, help sellers along their onboarding journey by delivering tailored, necessary training content, and support sellers after they begin transacting with Square
  • Learn and maintain a strong understanding of relevant product features and releases
  • Execute onboarding best practices consistently while escalating complex product or technical needs.
  • Balance the needs of numerous (20-30) sellers at any given time, ensuring successful completion of each onboarding engagement

Project / Process Execution (Estimated 20% of work)

  •  Identify issues or blockers that could affect a seller’s onboarding experience or go-live date, and escalate appropriately to senior team members or cross-functional partners.
  • Contribute to improvements in onboarding processes by documenting gaps, proposing refinements, and sharing observations from seller engagements.
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with assigned sellers and demonstrate the ability to maintain an onboarding tracker with key milestones, target dates, and next steps to keep sellers informed and on track for go-live.
  • Help sellers understand and complete the steps required for launch, following up on outstanding needs and confirming readiness ahead of their target go-live date.
  • Use AI to improve the seller experience and automate or enhance internal processes.

🤝 Team Collaboration & Skill Development (Estimated 10% of work)

  • Share best practices with peers and contribute to a positive team culture.
  • Take ownership of keeping product knowledge current, including new features, updates, and known limitations, to provide sellers with accurate guidance.
  • Support team knowledge areas (POS, Online, integrations) by developing product expertise and serving as a go-to resource for standard questions.
  • Participate in internal meetings, training, roadmap updates, and optimization discussions to build broader product and organizational understanding.
  • Escalate product, process, or policy issues clearly and promptly to senior teammates and product teams; assist in resolving routine internal or client concerns.
  • Demonstrate reliability and consistency in onboarding execution while learning to manage more complex workflows.
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume, high-tempo, customer-focused onboarding environment.

You Have (Qualifications):

  • 2–4+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, operations, or account management customer support, customer success; relevant industry experience (restaurant, services, retail) is a plus.
  • Demonstrated strong performance and consistency in onboarding work (metrics, CSAT, responsiveness, quality).
  • Experience managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with reliable delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professionalism in client and stakeholder interactions.
  • Proactive attitude and eagerness to learn; ability to apply feedback quickly.
  • Strong time-management and organizational skills.
  • Comfort operating through change and ambiguity with appropriate support.
  • Familiarity with project management practices.
  • Basic understanding of data analysis or reporting tools (Looker, Salesforce, etc.) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding and consistent usage of AI tools and platforms

Perks

At Square, we want you to be well and thrive. Our global benefits package includes:

  • Healthcare coverage
  • Retirement Plans
  • Work from home flexibility 
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Wellness perks
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off
  • Learning and Development resources

descriptions.job-1erwz1q:
As we continue to grow our presence in Romania and build a strong foundation for our local operations, we’re looking for a dedicated Administrative Business Partner to support our Site Leadership Team. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.

Summary

The Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative support to the Site Leadership Team, ensuring effective coordination of activities, meetings, and communications. You will facilitate seamless operations and serve as a critical communication link across offices and teams. You’ll anticipate the needs of the local leadership team, enabling the organization to stay focused on building a world-changing company.

In addition to being organized and analytical, you also have great communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions.

Responsibilities

  • General responsibilities:

    • Provide administrative support to the Site Leadership Team, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, taking minutes, and following up on action items.

    • Coordinate travel arrangements, expense reports, and logistics for site leadership members as needed.

    • Manage correspondence and communications, including emails, reports, and presentations.

    • Assist in organizing on-site and virtual events, town halls, and leadership meetings.

    • Maintain accurate records, files, and documentation relevant to site leadership activities.

    • Act as a liaison between site leadership and internal/external stakeholders.

    • Assist with internal communications and employee engagement initiatives in collaboration with HR and leadership.

    • Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

  • Specialized support for investment operations:

    • Collaborate closely with the designated leadership member involved in the company’s ventures arm to support the investment process.

    • Conduct background information check on teams from investments decks;

    • Utilize artificial intelligence tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to synthesize and summarize data.

    • Assist in coordinating and preparing materials for investment-related meetings, calls, and due diligence processes.

    • Monitor and ensure timely responses to inquiries related to investment opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

  • 2+ years of experience in an administrative or executive support role.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Romanian.

  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in leveraging them to improve efficiency, automate routine tasks, and find smarter ways of working

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Google Workspaces

  • Experience in event planning or project management

  • Highly organized, analytical, and flexible with shifting priorities

  • Strong business judgment and communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions, both internal and external

  • Ability to anticipate challenges before they arise and are known as a master organizer and sounding board. Your leadership team often calls on you to get things done

  • You are resilient, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy supporting a rapidly growing & changing organization

If you are a motivated and detail-oriented administrative professional looking to contribute to an exciting and innovative workplace, we’d love to hear from you!

Benefits & Perks


🏥 Private Health Insurance

💪 Gym Reimbursement

🌴 Flexible Time Off

🥙 In-Office Group Meals

🧠 Learning & Development Stipend

🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events

🎧 Books & Audiobook subscription with Bookster
descriptions.job-1o1otny:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is building the Private Equity channel into one of the company's most significant sources of enterprise growth. Sponsors and their operating teams shape how portfolio companies run finance, and when they standardize on a platform, they do it across dozens of companies at once.

This role will be focused on managing the largest funds in the market. You will own a book of the most strategic PE firms Ramp works with, many of which have multiple investment investment strategies, fund vehicles, and GP stakes businesses under a single name. Each one likely has a different operating partner for each strategy, a deal team with its own relationships, and portfolio CFOs who make the final call. Your job is to know all of them, keep every thread moving, and turn that access into measurable adoption across their portfolios.

It is a high-volume, high-stakes book. The work is relentless relationship management paired with genuine commercial discipline, and it carries the highest CP goal on the channel team. There are only a handful of these seats at Ramp, and real executive visibility comes with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own a book of upmarket and megafund PE partners, serving as their primary relationship owner at Ramp.

  • Multi-thread across each firm: operating partners by strategy, deal teams, platform and portfolio operations leaders, and portfolio-company CFOs.

  • Run disciplined portfolio analysis to find where Ramp can create value, and work with Account Executives to convert that into pipeline.

  • Generate and own qualified pipeline against an aggressive CP target, prioritizing the large opportunities that move the number.

  • Negotiate custom partnership structures where they make sense, including adoption commitments, and hold the line where terms do not work for Ramp.

  • Partner with Events, Growth, Marketing, and Finance to deliver sponsorships, webinars, executive dinners and the collateral your partners ask for.

  • Build and maintain the operating system behind the book: relationship maps, portfolio analysis, follow-ups and next steps across a large partner set on a tight touch cycle

  • Use AI to automate research, portfolio mapping, call prep and follow-through so the book scales beyond what manual effort allows

What You Need

  • A track record of carrying and hitting a high quota in a commercial role. Outbound sales development, account executive, or partnerships backgrounds all work.

  • Deep working knowledge of how a private equity firm is structured, including the distinct roles of operating partners, deal teams, and portfolio leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and expand relationships across a large, complex organization.

  • Exceptional organization and agency. History of managing a large book without dropping threads, continual follow-up, and navigating complex organizations.

  • Comfort negotiating directly with sophisticated counterparts, and the judgment to know when to walk away.

  • A practical, self-directed approach to AI. You build your own workflows rather than waiting for tooling.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts across events, growth, marketing and finance. Ability to work dynamically with others internally to drive results.

  • Willingness to travel frequently and to work from our New York office. CT or NJ with an in-office commitment also works, and we are open to relocation

Nice to Haves

  • Experience partnering with or selling to private equity firms and their portfolio companies.

  • Experience at a company with an established channel sales motion.

  • Fintech, payments, expense management, or CFO-software background.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

descriptions.job-1va02cu:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analytics Manager, you'll use data to strengthen Compliance across three priorities: Trusted Data, Growth Enablement, and Proactive Risk Prevention. You'll help ensure that regulatory reports, audit responses, and legal evidence are reliable, traceable, and reusable, while transforming customer, transaction, and financial data into actionable insights.
 
You'll partner with Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business teams to build trusted data foundations, automate recurring requests, and create metrics that reveal operational effectiveness and compliance friction. You'll also conduct root cause and control-gap analysis, help remove compliance-related business roadblocks, support market and licensing initiatives, and surface risks before they are identified externally.
 
What You'll Be Doing:
  • Facilitate and govern internal and external data requests across OKX global entities, ensuring timely, first-time-right delivery for regulatory reporting, audits and exams, and legal evidence.
  • Build and maintain request records, evidence and definition libraries, and data-governance records to improve data reliability, traceability, and reusability.
  • Productize high-frequency recurring requests into automated or self-service data pipelines, improving turnaround time and cost efficiency.
  • Build and automate Compliance dashboards based on North Star metrics as well as input and guardrail metrics to provide transparency into operational effectiveness, customer and platform risk, and business friction.
  • Conduct deep-dive, root-cause, and control-bypass analyses to proactively identify and prevent compliance risks.
  • Partner with Compliance, Business, Marketing, and local market teams to remove compliance-related roadblocks in current operations and support new markets, licences, applications, and market-access assessments.
  • Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Finance to continuously improve data pipelines and analytics products.
 
What We Look For In You:
  • Relevant working experience of at least 7 years. (must)
  • Proficiency in database management systems like MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. (must)
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. (must)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. (must)
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and AI tools. (nice to have)
  • Strong compliance domain knowledge, including KYC, AML, the Travel Rule, insider trading controls, and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions. (nice to have)
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting, regulatory examinations, and internal or external audits. (nice to have)
  • Preferred industries are Fintech, Digital Payment, Tech companies. (nice to have)
 
Perks & Benefits
  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
descriptions.job-0418sfi:
We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to own the overall technical architecture of the entire GoMining ecosystem, not just individual products. Your scope covers the architecture of all key domains (Payments, Cards, Custody, Wallet, Mining, and Core Platform) and the connections between them.

You will ensure that our products, platforms, infrastructure, and financial services operate as a scalable, secure, reliable, and interconnected ecosystem.

This is a highly influential role that requires both strategic architectural vision and deep hands-on engineering expertise. You will shape the target architecture, define technical standards, manage architectural dependencies, make critical technical decisions, and help teams choose the right path. You will work closely with the CTO, engineering leadership, and product teams.

Proven experience in FinTech, banking, payments, or cryptocurrency platforms is mandatory.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously evolve the end-to-end architecture of the GoMining ecosystem.
  • Define the target enterprise architecture, architectural principles, standards, and long-term technology roadmap.
  • Ensure architectural consistency and seamless integration across financial products, payments, wallets, custody, cards, mining services, and core platform infrastructure.
  • Design scalable and resilient distributed systems capable of supporting millions of users and high transaction volumes.
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries, service ownership, integration patterns, and data flows across multiple engineering teams.
  • Drive critical architecture decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Identify and eliminate architectural bottlenecks, technical debt, scalability limitations, and system dependencies.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide technical guidance to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with the CTO, Engineering Leads, Product Leaders, and business stakeholders to align technical architecture with business strategy.
  • Evaluate new technologies, architectural approaches, and infrastructure solutions.
  • Ensure security, reliability, observability, performance, and operational resilience are embedded into architectural decisions.
  • Remain deeply involved in technical discussions, solution design, and implementation reviews.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in enterprise, platform, or solution architecture roles.
  • Mandatory experience architecting systems within FinTech, banking, payments, digital banking, or cryptocurrency companies.
  • Proven experience designing architecture across multiple interconnected products, services, or business domains.
  • Strong software engineering background, ideally as a Senior / Lead / Principal Engineer.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, and integration patterns.
  • Experience designing high-load, fault-tolerant, and mission-critical systems.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Understanding of financial transaction processing, data consistency, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to define long-term architectural strategy while remaining technically hands-on.
  • Experience driving architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain infrastructure, digital wallets, or custody solutions.
  • Experience with card issuing, payment processing, banking integrations, or financial ledgers.
  • Experience building or transforming complex multi-product financial ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS, KYC, AML, and financial compliance requirements.
  • Experience scaling platforms to millions of users.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days +  8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).
descriptions.job-1t8fi7i:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for an Experiential Marketing Manager to produce the real-world experiences where traders, creators, partners, and builders meet MetaMask. You’ll lead production, help shape event strategy, and sharpen the creative execution.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the Experiential & Global Events team within MetaMask’s Creative Studio and report to the Director of Experiential Marketing. We concept, design, and produce the ways people meet MetaMask in real life across global conferences, community events, VIP experiences, co-branded activations, and more. Our calendar runs across the world with priorities across APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.  

You’ll lead production, taking each event from brief to on-site to recap. You’ll work cross-functionally with internal and external teams, rallying people from planning through production and on the ground. Your focus will be experiences for our most active users and co-branded work with brands and creators, alongside community events for the builders who create on MetaMask.

Our formats are expanding to include live trading competitions, viewing events, product launches, and private experiences for VIP traders and creator partners.

How You’ll Do It

  • Produce events and experiences end to end: venues, run of show, fabrication, AV, F&B, and staffing, working alongside our production agency partners.
  • Own timelines, workback plans, and budgets for multiple events running in parallel across regions.
  • Source, negotiate with, and manage agencies, venues, and vendors in APAC, the US, Europe and LATAM.
  • Run registration and guest management, from guest lists and approvals to VIP access and arrival.
  • Build programming for events and panels, including formats, session flow, and speaker coordination.
  • Keep the operational side tight: source-of-truth docs, trackers, internal team staffing, and on-the-ground comms during conference weeks. Build playbooks that make each event easier to run than the last, using AI tools to move faster.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across product, marketing, business development and more to turn briefs into event plans with clear audiences, objectives, and success metrics tied to product and business goals.
  • Help develop and refine concepts with the creative team. Bring a point of view on formats, venues, and cultural trends, and work with designers and copywriters on decks and creative deliverables.
  • Work with content capture teams so every event produces strong stories and shareable content.
  • Track post-event results, including attendance, registration data, and social reach and sentiment, and write recaps that show what worked and what to change.
  • Over time, help source and manage co-hosts and sponsors for our owned franchises.

We’re looking for someone with

  • 5+ years in event production, experiential marketing, or brand activations, ideally in fintech, crypto, consumer tech, esports, or entertainment.
  • Experience producing large-format or competitive live events, such as tournaments, launches, or live viewing events.
  • A track record of delivering multi-city or international events on time and on budget.
  • Experience managing agencies and vendors and negotiating contracts under tight deadlines.
  • Experience producing premium or invite-only experiences for high-value guests.
  • Strong initiative. You spot what needs to happen and do it before anyone asks, and you stay steady when the plan changes.
  • Strategic and creative judgment. You connect an event to a product or business goal, and you bring ideas that sharpen a concept.
  • A systems mindset. You turn one-off events into repeatable processes.
  • Clear, confident communication with stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership. Partners, vendors, and colleagues want to work with you again.
  • Based in the US or EU, and willing to travel internationally up to 20% of the year, typically 1 to 2 weeks per quarter across several markets.
  • Curiosity about money, markets, and how people trade, save, and spend. Finance experience isn’t required, but interest is.

It’s a bonus to have

  • Experience in crypto, whether producing events for digital asset audiences or at global conferences such as Token2049, Korea Blockchain Week, EthCC, or Devcon.
  • Experience sourcing or managing event co-hosts and sponsors.
  • Relationships with brands, creators, or communities that could become MetaMask partners.
  • An existing network of production vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, and Luma.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
$101,000—$141,000 USD

descriptions.job-0lzence:
Own Your Intelligence

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

Take Prime Intellect’s next open models from architecture experiments through full pre-training runs, scaling toward 1–3T parameters. You’ll work across the model and training stack, making research decisions and fixing the systems problems that determine whether a run succeeds.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend the pre-training code in prime-rl, taking small experiments into full training runs.

  • Evaluate model architecture changes, including MoE and attention designs, against model quality and training cost.

  • Profile training jobs and improve end-to-end throughput, working with systems engineers on hardware-aware execution.

  • Make long runs resilient to failures, with reliable checkpointing and recovery.

  • Investigate training dynamics and numerical stability, checking that optimizations preserve convergence.

  • Run controlled ablations to guide larger experiments, keeping the setup and results reproducible.

  • Work with data and evaluation researchers on training mixtures, including midtraining and long-context experiments.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training language models, including modifying training code and following the effects through actual runs.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or a comparable framework, with enough systems understanding to debug distributed training.

  • A practical understanding of model architectures and optimization, including their effect on convergence.

  • Ability to design an ablation that answers a research question and explain what its results do and don’t show.

  • Good judgment about what to investigate yourself and when to bring in a colleague.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect.

  • Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in-person at our offices in San Francisco.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates.

  • Quarterly team off-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities.

  • Opportunity to work with a talented, hard-working and mission-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.
descriptions.job-1m66tta:
About Us

DV Trading, LLC is a proprietary trading firm with over 200 employees trading equities, fixed income, FX and commodity products. DV Commodities is a rapidly growing division that specializes in trading crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and other commodities across US, European, and Asian markets. Our combined risk management, world class technology, and human capital have enabled us to become one of the largest liquidity providers within the global energy complex. 

Overview

DV is looking for a software engineer with a quantitative mindset to join a small team building the tools that power our commodities trading. You will work directly with traders and quants to turn ideas into production-grade quant trading tools, fundamental analysis models, and analytics, and you will own them from prototype through daily use.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Work alongside traders, quants and other engineers to build quant trading tools, including signal research, backtesting frameworks, and strategy monitoring
  • Develop and productionize fundamental models for energy markets, such as supply/demand balances, inventory and flow analysis, and curve and spread models
  • Build analytics and visualization tools that give traders clear, timely views of markets, positions, and PnL drivers
  • Design data pipelines that ingest, clean and store market, fundamental, and alternative data from internal and third-party sources
  • Create efficient storage and access schemes for time series, reference, and fundamental data
  • Integrate models and tools with our event-based risk, market data and pricing platform
  • Test, monitor and document models and tools, and iterate quickly based on trader feedback

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in CS, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or another quantitative discipline
  • 2+ years professional experience building quantitative trading tools, models, or analytics in a financial or commodities setting
  • Strong Python skills in a scientific computing environment (numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels or similar)
  • Solid grounding in statistics, time series analysis, and data modeling; machine learning experience is a plus
  • Experience building data pipelines and working with large data sets • Experience with SQL, NoSQL or tick databases
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Plotly/Dash, Streamlit, Grafana)
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms, design patterns, and OOP; Java or C++ is a plus
  • Experience working in a Unix environment and git
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Docker, Airflow, or Luigi
  • Strong communication skills in verbal and written English, with the ability to work closely with traders
  • Domain knowledge in energy markets, futures and swaps is a plus

Benefits

  • Discretionary bonus eligibility
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Options
  • Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D insurance

All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. descriptions.job-0sl2zse:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior IT & AI Platform Engineer to build, deploy, and operate enterprise systems, AI applications, and cloud infrastructure that help teams across a16z execute with speed, confidence, and security. You’ll lead complex technical deployments, serve as a trusted technical escalation point for stakeholders, manage privileged access across critical systems, and reduce friction through reliable automations and self-service workflows.

This is a hands-on role within the IT Systems team, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, Product, Data, and other business units across the firm. On a typical day, you’ll be orchestrating multiple AI coding agents, managing AWS or GCP infrastructure, and guiding a business unit to deploy a custom vibe-coded application. You’ll be expected to take on complex, often ambiguous or urgent requests, understand what’s needed, and deliver outcomes that are secure, well documented, and easy to support. 

This role requires an in-office presence 3 days a week in either our San Francisco, CA or Menlo Park, CA office.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Take ownership of the firm's toughest IT challenges around AI deployments, making consequential technical decisions and building lasting solutions that teams across a16z depend on
  • Co-own the technical implementation of new enterprise systems and emerging AI applications, including evaluating, testing, and deploying new capabilities securely and at scale
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil and build automations across the entire IT organization
  • Partner with business teams and internal builders to turn ideas into working applications—from early prototypes through deployment, hardening, and ongoing support
  • Build and operate AWS and GCP infrastructure
  • Partner with Cybersecurity to protect sensitive data and manage privileged access across AI, SaaS, cloud, endpoint, and internal systems
  • Work with internal stakeholders to support Databricks and cloud AI services, including workspace configuration, service principals, access controls, and operational monitoring
  • Serve as a trusted technical escalation point for cybersecurity, engineering, data, and other business units. Work with stakeholders to untangle complex problems and find a clear path forward
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis to restore service and prevent future issues across the firm’s enterprise systems
  • Maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and decision records, and share knowledge to help the IT team operate more effectively

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8 years of experience in platform engineering, systems administration, cloud infrastructure, or IT engineering, with responsibility for production systems
  • A power user of advanced AI workflows, going beyond such tools as ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Code, Wispr Flow
  • Experience transforming IT operations by leveraging AI
  • Experience deploying AI applications with enterprise systems and data, including SSO, provisioning, integrations, permissions, administrative controls, and staged rollouts
  • Experience shipping internal applications or tools from prototype to production, including authentication, API integrations, deployment, and ongoing support
  • Hands-on AWS and GCP experience, including IAM, networking, application hosting, storage, and logging, plus infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
  • Experience administering or supporting Databricks, including workspaces, service principals, permissions, and monitoring, in partnership with data engineering teams
  • Experience administering modern enterprise infrastructure and SaaS ecosystems such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Jamf, Intune, and cloud-native environments
  • Experience building maintainable automations and API integrations using code and low-code/no-code platforms, with version control, testing, monitoring, and safe deployment practices
  • Ability to diagnose complex problems across enterprise systems, infrastructure, identity, and integrations, and weigh security, reliability, cost, and user experience when choosing solutions
  • Experience making changes to production systems with adequate testing, monitoring, rollback plans, and responding effectively when things go wrong, and communicating appropriately throughout.
  • Low ego, high empathy: you listen to different perspectives, question your assumptions, and use evidence to find the best solutions
  • High agency: you take initiative, manage priorities, navigate ambiguity, collaborate effectively, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers

The anticipated salary range for this role is between $221,000 - $258,000 actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.

This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

a16z culture

  • We are all different, we recognize that, and we win
  • We celebrate the good times
  • We do it for the team

At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.

descriptions.job-0nnel4e:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Corporate Technology (CorpTech) Services team is a strategic support partner to all Stripes, in office and remote.  We ensure the successful operation of new hires, account off-boards and critical business systems with a global team. 

We’re looking for a Tier 1 Support Engineer to join the AMER CorpTech Services team to provide in-person, thoughtful and individualized support for all Stripes. Stripe is looking for individuals who can work in a fast paced environment and work autonomously to deliver team oriented results.

What you’ll do

You’ll be responsible for providing technical assistance and support related to computer systems, hardware, and software. Respond to queries, run diagnostic programs, isolate problems, and determine and implement solutions.  In-person support is required as well as setting up desks and managing/auditing peripherals.  

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware.
  • Respond to queries either in person, email, Slack or ticketing system.
  • Provide in-person IT HelpDesk assistance to Stripe employees, contingent workers, and vendors.
  • Walk customers through problem-solving processes and follow up to ensure issues have been resolved.
  • Run diagnostic programs to resolve problems as well as troubleshoot IT scripts, systems, or automation
  • Support and maintain critical SaaS tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, JIRA, Confluence, etc.)

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Possess 2+ years of experience in IT HelpDesk experience

  • Possess strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, JIRA, Confluence, or similar cloud providers

descriptions.job-10p18by:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Toronto or New York City office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. You will participate in an on-call rotation covering 8:00am–4:00pm ET.

This is a player-coach role: you'll lead a small team of infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on in the engineering work itself. You'll be an extra set of hands on your team's projects, take on smaller initiatives yourself so the team can stay focused on roadmap work, and help build, shape, and execute our infrastructure roadmap. Expect to spend roughly 60% of your time on hands-on engineering and 40% on leading the team.

What you'll do

Lead the team

  • Lead and develop a small team of talented infrastructure engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career development
  • Help shape a team culture of open communication, craftsmanship, and ownership
  • Take direct responsibility for the quality and delivery of the team's work
  • Participate in hiring and growing the team
  • Protect the team's focus by triaging incoming requests and unplanned work, so engineers can stay on roadmap priorities

Stay hands-on

  • Be an extra set of hands on your team's projects: pair on hard problems, unblock work, review designs and code, and pick up pieces of larger efforts when it helps the team move faster
  • Own and deliver smaller infrastructure initiatives end to end
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation (8:00am–4:00pm ET), act as a technical leader during production incidents, and drive postmortems and follow-up work
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code, automation, and engineering best practices, leading by example

Shape the roadmap

  • Partner with the Head of Infrastructure to build, shape, and execute the infrastructure roadmap
  • Translate long-term goals into concrete, shippable milestones, and plan, estimate, and make tradeoffs with your team
  • Own and be accountable for KPIs covering the reliability, resiliency, and uptime of critical services
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to identify infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, including cloud cost optimization
  • Facilitate thorough documentation and knowledge sharing

What we're looking for

We are looking for teammates who share and practice our values: open communication, transparency, taking ownership, and a high level of craftsmanship.

Required

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, building and operating complex, high-stakes production systems
  • 2+ years leading a team of engineers, including people leadership responsibilities such as 1:1s, feedback, and performance conversations
  • A track record of balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership
  • Extensive experience securing, scaling, and operating Kubernetes in production, with associated tooling (ArgoCD, GitOps, Grafana) and advanced Terraform
  • Hands-on experience with a major public cloud provider. We operate primarily on AWS but believe skills in one cloud provider translate to others
  • Strong Linux systems administration skills and networking fundamentals (VPCs, security groups, load balancers, CNI plugins, network policy management)
  • Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language, preferably Go, with strong bash scripting
  • Operational experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience participating in and organizing on-call rotations, and leading incident response
  • Strong project management skills and experience collaborating across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

  • Security operations experience, including vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience with compliance frameworks and audit lifecycles (SOC, ISO, regulators, etc.)
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience
  • Deep observability experience (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, ELK)
  • Experience sourcing and hiring engineering talent
  • A history of delivering internal tools or automation that improved developer or operator workflows
  • Blockchain/crypto infrastructure experience, such as running nodes and validators
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $205,000 and $250,000 CAD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
descriptions.job-19jdiy6:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

Figure is looking for a Principal Product Designer to help shape the future of our financial products, with a primary focus on Figure Markets and opportunities to work across our broader lending ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who thrives in complex, ambiguous problem spaces. You will work on products that span investing, lending, borrowing, digital assets, capital markets, and emerging financial infrastructure, often in areas where the product model itself is still being defined.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business leaders to turn complicated financial concepts, technical constraints, regulatory requirements, and evolving customer needs into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and trustworthy.

We are looking for someone who can move fluidly between big-picture product thinking and detailed execution. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying gaps in requirements, working through downstream logic and edge cases, and helping a team determine not just how a feature should work, but what the right product experience should be. At the Principal level, your impact should extend beyond the projects directly assigned to you. You will help establish patterns, improve how teams approach difficult design problems, mentor other designers, and raise the quality of product design across Figure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead product design for complex initiatives across Figure Markets, while contributing to shared problems and experiences across Figure Lending and other products.
  • Take ambiguous or incomplete product requirements and turn them into coherent end-to-end experiences, identifying missing logic, dependencies, edge cases, and opportunities along the way.
  • Develop a deep understanding of financial concepts, customer workflows, business models, and technical constraints in order to simplify inherently complicated products.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering from early problem definition through implementation, helping shape requirements rather than simply designing against them.
  • Explore multiple approaches to difficult problems, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and help teams make informed product decisions.
  • Design sophisticated workflows, data-dense interfaces, account and transaction experiences, permissions, states, and other interaction models common to financial products.
  • Think beyond the primary happy path. Anticipate error states, lifecycle changes, permissions, regulatory constraints, system behavior, and downstream consequences of design decisions.
  • Create prototypes and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and help teams align quickly.
  • Work within and contribute to Figure’s evolving design system, identifying opportunities to establish reusable patterns without forcing unique product problems into generic solutions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering during implementation to preserve intent, resolve unexpected constraints, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
  • Use research, customer feedback, product data, domain expertise, and cross-functional input to inform design decisions.
  • Present work clearly to partners and senior leadership, explaining not only what you designed but how you arrived at the solution.
  • Provide thoughtful critique and mentorship to other designers, helping raise the quality of both the work and the thinking behind it.
  • Identify patterns and opportunities that span individual products, helping Figure create more coherent experiences across Markets, Lending, and future product areas.

What We Look For

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including significant experience owning complex products or major product areas.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft across real, shipped experiences.
  • A track record of solving complicated problems where requirements, customer needs, or the underlying product model were not fully defined at the outset.
  • Strong systems thinking and an ability to understand how decisions in one part of a product affect workflows, states, users, and systems elsewhere.
  • Excellent interaction design skills, particularly for sophisticated workflows, data-heavy products, and multi-step experiences.
  • Strong visual design fundamentals and a high bar for typography, hierarchy, layout, information density, interaction detail, and overall product polish.
  • The ability to independently drive work from early problem framing through detailed design and implementation.
  • Comfort working closely with engineers and understanding enough about technical systems to make pragmatic design decisions.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complicated concepts and design rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience influencing Product and Engineering partners and constructively challenging requirements when a better customer or product outcome is possible.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to give and receive direct, thoughtful critique.
  • A customer-first approach that prioritizes clarity, trust, and usability over novelty or personal aesthetic preference.
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing fintech, trading, investing, lending, crypto, capital markets, payments, or other financial products.
  • Experience working in regulated industries where compliance, permissions, disclosures, and operational constraints meaningfully affect the product experience.
  • Familiarity with institutional or professional financial workflows in addition to consumer products.
  • Experience with products involving complex account structures, transaction lifecycles, roles and permissions, or financial data.
  • Experience contributing to design systems and establishing reusable product patterns across teams.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies and modern product development workflows.
  • Experience using prototyping and emerging AI tools to explore ideas, accelerate iteration, or improve the design and development process.

How You'll Make an Impact

Success in this role is not measured by the number of screens you produce. It is measured by your ability to bring clarity to difficult problems, improve the decisions a team makes, and create products that make sophisticated financial capabilities understandable and usable. You will help Figure build products that can support increasing complexity without feeling increasingly complicated, while raising the standard for product thinking and execution across the organization.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $158,400 - $237,600/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing  and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Senior CX Solution Design Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the solution design and delivery of complex Digital Asset client engagements. Engagements can range from delivering expert design and implementation advice to hands-on software delivery.

The role combines deep expertise in product management, business analysis, enterprise software delivery, Daml, and the Canton Network with strong client leadership and cross-functional execution.

Operating as a player-architect, the Senior CX Solution Design Lead ensures complex client objectives are translated into practical solution designs, structured implementation plans, actionable requirements, guiding the solution end-to-end to ensure a successful final delivery. The role independently coordinates across clients, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other internal teams to drive successful outcomes while ensuring solutions align with Digital Asset’s architectural and delivery standards.

The role also serves as a functional and solution-design authority within CX, raising the quality of client deliverables, mentoring less-experienced colleagues, and identifying opportunities to improve the way complex client engagements are delivered.

Responsibilities:

Lead Complex Solution Design & Client Delivery

  • Leads the solution design and day-to-day execution of complex client engagements involving Daml, the Canton Network, and enterprise software implementations
  • Translates client business objectives and requirements into structured solution designs, implementation approaches, delivery plans, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Independently leads complex workstreams across multiple teams, managing dependencies, decisions, risks, and competing priorities
  • Serves as a senior functional and solution-design authority throughout the engagement lifecycle
  • Leads client steering committee meetings and other senior stakeholder forums, providing clear updates on delivery progress, risks, decisions, and recommended actions
  • Identifies potential client blockers, resource constraints, and delivery risks early and develops practical mitigation plans

Drive Business Analysis & Functional Design

  • Leads and reviews business analysis and functional requirements for complex client solutions
  • Develops and elevates high-quality user stories, process flows, UML diagrams, Gherkin scenarios, and other functional design artifacts
  • Facilitate complex discovery and design sessions with clients and translate outcomes into clear requirements, decisions, and implementation priorities.
  • Analyze business processes and technology environments to identify root causes, dependencies, and opportunities for improved solution design.
  • Clearly articulate how proposed technology and business-process designs support the client's business case and desired outcomes.

Apply Daml & Canton Expertise

  • Applies deep knowledge of Daml, the Canton Network, distributed ledger technology, and enterprise application architecture to complex client challenges
  • Guides solution approaches that align with Digital Asset's architectural principles, product capabilities, and implementation best practices
  • Identifies architectural, integration, and implementation risks and work with internal technical teams to develop effective solutions
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on Daml and Canton-related solution design within CX and across relevant internal teams

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

  • Coordinates independently across CX, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other functions to ensure effective execution of client solutions
  • Manages cross-team dependencies and resolve technical or procedural misalignments without requiring routine escalation to senior leadership
  • Maintains strong transparency across internal and external teams, ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility into priorities, decisions, progress, and risks
  • Provides guidance to external partners and vendors involved in client solution delivery
  • Establishes appropriate delivery practices, documentation standards, communication cadences, and quality checks within assigned engagements and workstreams

Support Sales & Client Expansion

  • Supports a seamless transition from pre-sales to post-sales by ensuring requirements, commitments, assumptions, and solution decisions are clearly documented
  • Identifies recurring client needs and opportunities for reusable solutions, services, or product improvements

Influence Product Development

Raise Quality & Develop Expertise

  • Shares knowledge, methodologies, and best practices across CX and contributes to the development of reusable tools, frameworks, and delivery approaches
